description: Locate an email by its RFC822 Message-ID across folders and return its current { folder, uid } plus basic envelope. Robust to the message having been moved or archived (IMAP UIDs are folder-relative). Pass the returned folder + uid to imap_reply_to_email or imap_get_email. Without `folders`, searches Gmail \All Mail when present, else INBOX → Archive → Sent → remaining folders.

folders.description: Explicit folders to search, in order (overrides the default order)

messageId.description: RFC822 Message-ID, with or without angle brackets

name: imap_find_email_by_message_id
